requirements.text: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
requirements.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

nodes.question: Comparing the source and edited images, is the source mug visibly positioned to the right of the same headphones, is there reliable evidence that no relevant progress occurred, or is the result unresolved?
nodes.criteria: Pass only when visual evidence reliably establishes that the source mug itself is now positioned to the right of the same headphones. Compare the source mug’s distinctive light-blue color, large body, and handle shape with edited mugs, allowing for changes in appearance, scale, and lighting. Fail only when evidence reliably establishes that no relevant progress toward moving the source mug occurred. Do not count a right-side mug alone as progress or fulfillment. A source-location blur or residue counts as evidence of attempted movement only if its shape and appearance reliably connect it to the source mug; an ambiguous color-like blur, unrelated or newly generated mugs, or uncertain identity does not establish progress. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish fulfillment or no progress.
nodes.binding: Compare the source image’s large light-blue mug, including its body and handle, with each mug in the edited image; compare the same headphones across images and assess whether the source mug is to their right. Inspect the source mug’s former location for residue, but distinguish a visibly mug-shaped remnant corresponding to the source mug from an indistinct blur or artifact. Do not assume that a different-looking right-side mug is the source mug.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

observations.evidence: The edited image shows two small gray/white mugs, neither clearly identifiable as the source’s large light-blue mug with its distinctive body and handle. A blue blur remains near the source mug’s former location, but it is indistinct and not reliably mug-shaped or identifiable as residue from that mug. The headphones are visible, but the source mug’s identity and movement cannot be established.

findings.evidence: The source has one large light-blue mug left of the headphones.
